text:
olivia: Just opened PR 1801 to add a tiny migration note about trace ID hex formatting and to update the Console dashboard preview screenshot + SDK snippets. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1801
mark: Nice. What do you mean by hex formatting? Is this about trace IDs switching to 32-char lowercase?
olivia: Yes 1) SDKs now surface trace IDs as lowercase 32-char hex. 2) the console Viewer UI expects lowercase for linking to spans. Need a short callout in the trace hook docs so users know to normalize.
kevin: Also saw the dashboard preview image is outdated (shows old metric names). I can regenerate a small PNG from staging and update the image path in the markdown.
luna: For SDK snippets I suggest adding a one-liner that normalizes the id: `trace_id = trace_id.lower().zfill(32)` and a note about older traces still being matched case-insensitively for 30 days.
olivia: Good call. Can we also add a tiny YAML snippet for Private deployments showing collector endpoint env var and note about firewall rules? Keeps it brief.
mark: I'll update the markdown with code fences and the YAML snippet. Also will swap metric names to `latency_p95_ms` and `cost_usd_per_request` in the screenshot caption so it's consistent.
kevin: Uploaded new screenshot to /assets/docs/console/dashboard-preview-v2.png and pushed. I trimmed the image width to 900px to keep site layout stable.
luna: I patched the Python + Node snippets to include the id-normalize line and a short comment on fallback exporters. Pushed to the branch.
docs-bot: linkcheck: image path /assets/docs/console/dashboard-preview-v2.png OK. build-docs queued.
olivia: Quick ask: can someone take the backport to release/1.2-docs? This affects Dedicated customers who import dashboard JSONs.
mark: I'll file the backport PR after merge.
docs-bot: build-docs: All checks passed for branch docs/1801. Will merge in 3 minutes if no objections.
olivia: Thanks all 1 :sparkles: After merge I'll add a one-line test plan to the PR body: import dashboard JSON to staging, verify hover links to traces work with lowercase IDs, smoke SDK snippet locally.
